claims.claim: For engine seatng and engines mouthing
claims.evidence: Witness report shows assorted car suspension/engine mount-related parts (rubber mounts, brackets, housings) but does not confirm exact intended use as stated by the seller (engine seating/engine mounting) or which specific pieces match that purpose.

risks.risk: Wrong fit/compatibility (unknown vehicle make/model and exact specifications).
risks.proof: A clear photo of any part numbers/markings on the rubber mounts or metal brackets, plus a photo showing the full set laid out with labels/measurements (bolt hole size/spacing).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed, unverified-fit used suspension/engine-mount components (worst-case: may not fit or may require replacement).

risks.risk: Incomplete set / missing hardware (bolts, nuts, brackets, or matching pairs).
risks.proof: A full spread photo showing every piece present, with a count of mounts/brackets and a close-up of any bolts/hardware included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/assorted parts with no guarantee of a usable complete mounting set.

risks.risk: Rubber degradation (torn/aged rubber) leading to poor performance or failure.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of each rubber mount showing cracks/tears, plus a photo of the rubber surface condition (not just dusty/greasy areas).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/aged mounts (worst-case: only scrap/low usability).

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion on metal brackets/arms affecting strength or causing seized/blocked mounting points.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of pivot/bolt areas and any holes/threads, showing whether holes are clean and whether bolts can pass through.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as rusted used brackets with uncertain structural integrity.

risks.risk: Unclear whether parts are engine mounts vs other suspension bushings/brackets (could be mixed categories).
risks.proof: Photos showing each component’s shape and any markings, ideally with a reference to known engine mount geometry (e.g., mounting flange/engine-side vs chassis-side).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as assorted suspension/engine-mount related parts with uncertain exact function.

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of any part numbers/markings on the rubber mounts and metal brackets.
Send a full laid-out photo showing the total quantity and each piece clearly (including any bolts/hardware present).
Provide close-ups of the rubber condition for every mount (show cracks/tears and bolt-hole condition).
Provide close-ups of the pivot/bolt areas and holes/threads to confirm they are not seized or unusable.
Confirm the exact vehicle make/model (and engine type if applicable) these mounts fit, and show a photo of the mounts compared to that reference if possible.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as assorted used car suspension/engine-mount related parts (rubber mounts and brackets), so it can be priced at its worst-case as mixed, worn, and unverified-fit components. Seller wording about engine seating/mounting is not confirmed by the report, so the price should assume the lowest usability until proof is provided.
